title: Sell Mineral Rights in Parshall, ND
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Parshall, ND
metaDescription: Own mineral rights in Parshall, ND, home of the field that started the modern Bakken boom? Get a real offer grounded in your well's history.
heroLead: Parshall gave its name to the field, and the field gave its name to a whole era of North Dakota history, which means owning minerals here comes with more attention, and more offers, than almost anywhere else we cover.
intro: EOG's discovery well here in the spring of 2006 is generally credited with proving the Bakken could be developed profitably at scale using modern horizontal drilling, and the field around Parshall has stayed one of the strongest producers in the play ever since. If your family has owned minerals here since before that well came in, you've likely seen your interest go from a quiet legacy holding to a real income source almost overnight.

sections.heading: Some of the best rock in the entire Bakken
paragraphs: Parshall field acreage has supported repeated development over the years, from the original vertical-to-horizontal wells through later infill drilling targeting the Three Forks bench beneath the original Bakken producers. That means many Parshall-area spacing units now have multiple wellbores, which we account for directly when we look at your specific tract.

sections.heading: Why Parshall owners get so many competing offers
paragraphs: Because this field's history is well known, Parshall mineral owners tend to hear from more buyers than owners in quieter counties. Some of those offers are fair, some are priced hoping you won't check. We show you the actual well data behind our number so you can compare honestly.

sections.heading: What the discovery-well history means for today's owners
paragraphs: Wells drilled in the years right after 2006 are now well past their peak, and a lot of Parshall families are sitting on royalty checks that are a fraction of what they were in the boom's early years. That's the normal shape of a Bakken well's life, and it's a big part of why owners weigh selling now against holding through a long, slow decline.
We'll show you where your specific well sits on that curve, using actual production data rather than a general estimate, before we talk about what we'd pay.

faqs.question: Is Parshall field still worth as much as it was during the initial boom?
faqs.answer: Wells here are past their peak, which is normal, but the field remains one of the strongest in the Bakken with continued infill development. Current value reflects today's decline stage, priced fairly against recent production.

faqs.question: How many wells are actually producing under our Parshall acreage?
faqs.answer: Send us your legal description and we'll check the state well index to identify every wellbore tied to your spacing unit before we quote anything.

faqs.question: We keep getting mailers offering to buy our minerals. How do we know what's fair?
faqs.answer: Ask any buyer to show you the well data behind their number. We always do, so you can compare our offer against others with real information.

faqs.question: Does our interest include both the original well and any later infill wells?
faqs.answer: We check the full well history for your spacing unit, since many Parshall-area tracts now have multiple wellbores across both the Bakken and Three Forks.
